content-quality.description: Content-quality profile for the nightly content lane's self-heal loop. Every step here is already a container-prepush step; this profile is the subset that judges what a content release just wrote, so scripts/selfheal/heal_until_clean.mjs can repair -> rebuild -> revalidate -> retry against it without re-running build:all on each attempt. It weakens nothing: the same steps still run, unchanged, in container-prepush.

profile_exclusions.MX-151: post-release freeze-state check, not a per-push check. It runs inside the release lane: scripts/authority_scale/run_guarded_release.mjs calls prepare-drift-scope, then authority:scale:freeze, then this validator, so the registry is re-snapshotted before it is checked. Between releases it reports drift by design - every commit that lands on main after a release run makes the frozen registry older than the tree. Verified 2026-08-29: the freeze command IS invoked (run_guarded_release.mjs line 10); the earlier reason -- fails on the current tree, real finding, not yet triaged -- was wrong and read as an unresolved defect.

profile_exclusions.MX-199: NAMED STOP: this validator was orphaned (no registry record, no npm script, nothing invoking it) and on its first run it hard-fails with a CONFIRMED defect it was written to catch - duplicate canonicals where both a directory index and a sibling .html claim the same URL (billionaire-high-performance-coach, faq). The pages and routing that produce that duplication are build/content territory, not the validation owner's, so arming it into container-prepush would turn a green lane red for a defect this agent cannot fix. Registered and named here so the debt is visible and countable; arm it into container-prepush in the same change that removes the duplicate canonicals.
profile_exclusions.MX-RELEASE-CONVERGE-BEFORE-FREEZE: release-time or generator command, not a per-push check: it runs build:all and the ordered repair stages to a fixed point, which is the release lane's own work and would recurse inside a validation profile. Its ordering is guarded per-push by VAL-FREEZE-AFTER-CONVERGENCE.

profile_exclusions_policy: Admitted entries that are deliberately not profile steps, each with the reason. validate_validation_registry warns only about entries missing from this map, so an unreviewed orphan is visible while a reasoned exclusion is not noise. Entries marked NEEDS TRIAGE are real failures or real environment gaps that should be fixed and then armed - they are not permanent exclusions.
